subject.title: Google Chat: Add user OAuth support for reactions and media uploads

question: Should the bundled Google Chat plugin add a first-class user OAuth credential surface for reactions, native uploads, reaction typing, and proactive DM lookup now, or should it remain service-account-only with narrower fallbacks?
rationale: This adds new credential/config surface, refresh-token handling, scoped API routing, and security expectations, so automation should not choose the product/security direction on its own.

options.title: Approve plugin-owned OAuth design
options.body: Implement OAuth inside the Google Chat plugin with SecretRef/redaction support, scoped clients, absent-OAuth fallback behavior, docs, and regression coverage.

options.title: Limit work to fallback mitigations
options.body: Land or choose a media-link fallback for app-auth upload failures and keep reactions/native uploads/proactive DMs unsupported until the broader OAuth design is sponsored.

options.title: Defer bundled OAuth
options.body: Keep core Google Chat service-account-only for now and require an external plugin or separate design proposal for user OAuth parity.

recommendation.title: Approve plugin-owned OAuth design
recommendation.body: Implement OAuth inside the Google Chat plugin with SecretRef/redaction support, scoped clients, absent-OAuth fallback behavior, docs, and regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete posted the prior maintainer-side review on this issue and appears in the foundational/recent Google Chat history as committer and reviewer.
